messages.subject: Supa Update November 2026
messages.body_text:
Everything that happened in the last month at Supabase

Supabase

*******************************
Supabase Update — November 2026
*******************************

Hey there 👋,

Here’s everything that happened with Supabase in the last month:

Supabase now works with Grok Bot

--------------------------------
Supabase now works with Grok Bot
--------------------------------

With Grok Bot connected to Cursor, anyone on your team can request a change in chat, and Cursor builds and runs it on your Supabase backend through the Supabase MCP server.

Read the blog → ( https://supabase.com/blog/ship-changes-to-your-supabase-backend-with-grok-bot )

Supabase .NET SDK is now officially supported

---------------------------------------------
Supabase .NET SDK is now officially supported
---------------------------------------------

v8 puts every package under one version number and adds a dependency injection package for registering Supabase in ASP.NET Core.

Read the blog → ( https://supabase.com/blog/introducing-the-unified-supabase-net-sdk )

Stripe Data Pipeline now syncs real-time data to Supabase

---------------------------------------------------------
Stripe Data Pipeline now syncs real-time data to Supabase
---------------------------------------------------------

Pick a Supabase project from the Stripe Dashboard and Stripe backfills your payment, customer, and subscription data into your own database and keeps it in sync, with no webhooks to maintain, so you can query it alongside everything else your app stores. Available in public preview.

Read the blog → ( https://supabase.com/blog/stripe-data-pipeline-now-syncs-real-time-data-to-supabase )

Supabase Knowledge Base is live in public beta

----------------------------------------------
Supabase Knowledge Base is live in public beta
----------------------------------------------

Troubleshooting and migration guides for developers and their agents.

Visit the Knowledge Base → ( https://supabase.com/kb )

Status page moves to incident.io

--------------------------------
Status page moves to incident.io
--------------------------------

status.supabase.com now runs on incident.io: Email subscribers carry over automatically, but SMS, Slack, webhook, and RSS subscribers all need to resubscribe, and the new page only supports Email, RSS, and Slack going forward.

View the changelog → ( https://supabase.com/changelog/status-page-migration )

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------
Quick Product Announcements
---------------------------

* Query your database and manage projects from Make scenarios and AI agents, connected with your Supabase account through the MCP server, on every Make plan (open beta on Make's side). [Blog ( https://supabase.com/blog/automate-your-supabase-backend-with-make )]
* Supabase Go SDK is now in public alpha. Verify end-user access tokens and query your database as that user under Row Level Security, now from Go. [GitHub ( https://github.com/supabase/supabase-go )]
* Organization invites on Team and Enterprise now support a No access role, so you can add someone to the org with no project access until an admin grants it. [Changelog ( https://supabase.com/changelog/no-access-org-role )]
* Four outdated TLS 1.2 ciphers will be removed from project HTTP APIs starting Nov 10 at the earliest, so clients on end-of-life systems may need updating. Direct Postgres and pooler connections are not affected. [Changelog ( https://supabase.com/changelog/cbc-tls-ciphers-deprecated )]

----------------------
Meet the Supabase team
----------------------

* KubeCon North America, Nov 9 to 12 in Salt Lake City: visit us at booth 227. [Event ( https://events.linuxfoundation.org/kubecon-cloudnativecon-north-america/ )]
* AWS re:Invent, Nov 30 to Dec 4 in Las Vegas: visit us at booth 2183. [Event ( https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/ )]
* Stacksync x Supabase, Nov 17 in Midtown Manhattan, NYC: join us for fireside chats on AI agents that do real work. [Event ( https://luma.com/stacksync-supabase-nyc )]
* Supabase × iru x Claude Community Meetup, Nov 11 in Dublin. [Event ( https://luma.com/supabase-sziy )]
* Dreambase Supabase meetup, Nov 12 in Denver. [Event ( https://luma.com/veetlvjc )]
* Supabase Meetup, Nov 17 in Tokyo. [Event ( https://luma.com/supabase-eh6n )]

------------------
Made with Supabase
------------------

* Langtok - a Spanish learning app that feels like scrolling social media. Swipe through short stories with word-by-word subtitles, tap any word to translate it, and learn frequent words. [App Store ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/langtok-learn-spanish/id6756219777 )]
* Firmin - helps small and medium-sized businesses manage internal processes like holiday requests, contracts, and employee working time. [Website ( https://firmin.cloud/ )]
* Primary AI - answers clinical questions for Canadian clinicians, with citations verified against PubMed and DOI lookups. [Website ( https://primaryai.world/ )]
* Cornerman - an AI coach that keeps you on track with your goals. Pick a coach style to get clear next steps and regular check-ins to build discipline. [App Store ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cornerman-ai-coach-mentor/id6739544014 )]

--------------------
Community Highlights
--------------------

* Setting up and deploying a car rental management SaaS with Supabase for the database and auth, with Claude Code handling the setup. [Video ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PePD54ZeHJQ )]
* A walkthrough of moving a Google Apps Script app's data from Sheets to a Supabase Postgres database. [Video ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VJKMQi-4UI )]
* How to build against local Supabase with the CLI and migration files, with Claude Code writing the schema as versioned migrations. [Video ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JllzgqiOF34 )]

------------
We're Hiring
------------

Come join one of the fastest-growing open source projects ever 🤗.

We are hiring across all departments ( https://supabase.com/careers ). Here are the Jobs of the Month:

* Product Lead - Infrastructure ( https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/supabase/47bcfdb8-b954-423e-8a9e-85256434575c )
* Product Manager - Strategic Partner Integrations (regular travel to Bay Area) ( https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/supabase/68a397e7-8a1a-4566-ae41-e8c61dd6ed93 )
* Software Engineer - Auth ( https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/supabase/e569b7f7-fa8f-4139-86f6-4f52b456882d )
* Support Engineer (AMER - Weekends) ( https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/supabase/dcf09dfe-55bc-44ba-b5db-1a2de7f33216 )

------------------------
⚠️ Baking hot meme zone ⚠️
------------------------

Meme of the month ( https://x.com/supabase/status/2110372776011825539 )

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

messages.body_text:
Get started with Modal — add a payment method to unlock your monthly free usage.


  
    
  
  
    Hi Setthi,

We'd love to help you get started with Modal so you can experience the power and flexibility of the platform firsthand. Get $30 in free usage each month once you add a valid payment method.

Open Modal dashboard: https://modal.com/?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later

LLM inference → (https://modal.com/endpoints/?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later)

Cognition, Decagon, Fathom, and DoorDash run production LLM inference on Modal. Get started with Auto Endpoints (https://modal.com/blog/introducing-auto-endpoints?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later) — the fastest path from model to endpoint.

Sandboxes for agents and RL → (https://modal.com/docs/guide/sandboxes?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later)

Spin up isolated, ephemeral containers programmatically. Used by teams building coding agents, background agents, and RL rollout pipelines at scale.

Training → (https://modal.com/docs/examples/llm-finetuning?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later)

From single-GPU fine-tuning to multi-node runs (https://modal.com/docs/guide/multi-node-training?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later) on B200s — launch experiments without managing clusters or reserving capacity.

Batch and async workloads → (https://modal.com/docs/guide/batch-processing?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later)

Evals, embeddings, re-ranking, dataset generation — spawn thousands of parallel jobs with one line of code. No orchestration to manage.

Or run any of our examples (https://modal.com/docs/examples?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later) for free.

If you have any questions, reach out to support@modal.com (mailto:support@modal.com) or message us on Slack (https://modal.com/slack?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_2_days_later).

— The Modal team

  
  
    © Modal Labs, Inc. · 233 Spring Street, New York, NY 10013

messages.subject: The Sitepeel Chrome extension is free now
messages.body_text:
The Sitepeel Chrome extension is free now

Hi, more news from Sitepeel. Last time I said the Chrome extension would be free soon. It is now, in version 1.1. The 24-hour trial is gone: sign in for free and use it, no card needed.

- Inspect, now with prompts: Click any button or section to copy its HTML and CSS, or a prompt your AI tool can rebuild it from.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/f1d1cdf2f462815189d52213e3349281/tools
- New: Tech stack: See what any site is built with, right from the dock.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/f1d1cdf2f462815189d52213e3349281/tools
- New: AI slop checker: See how AI-made a site looks, with each tell marked right on the page.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/f1d1cdf2f462815189d52213e3349281/tools
- Your tools, your way: Hide the tools you don’t use, or move the dock to the side of the page, from the dashboard.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/f1d1cdf2f462815189d52213e3349281/watch

Already have Sitepeel? Chrome updates it on its own. If you removed it when the trial ended, you can add it again (https://sitepeel.dev/e/f1d1cdf2f462815189d52213e3349281/install).

Want to see it first? Watch the 5-minute walkthrough (https://sitepeel.dev/e/f1d1cdf2f462815189d52213e3349281/watch) of all 15 tools.

Lifetime access: Every tool and every update for a one-time payment. No subscription.

Add to Chrome: https://sitepeel.dev/e/f1d1cdf2f462815189d52213e3349281/install

If something breaks, or there’s a tool you wish we had, just reply. I read every email.

Thanks,
Joseph from Sitepeel

---
You’re getting this because you have a Sitepeel account. Unsubscribe from news emails: https://sitepeel.dev/e/f1d1cdf2f462815189d52213e3349281/unsubscribe
Sign-in codes and receipts still arrive.
Sitepeel · https://sitepeel.dev

messages.subject: Sitepeel is free on the website now
messages.body_text:
Sitepeel is free on the website now

Hi, quick news from Sitepeel. The tools now run right on sitepeel.dev, and they’re free. Paste any website link, pick a tool, and the result shows on the page. Nothing to install.

- DESIGN.md generator: A site’s colors, fonts, spacing and components in one file your AI agent can build from.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/designmd
- Clone prompt: One prompt that rebuilds the page in Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable or v0.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/clone
- AI slop checker: How AI-made a site looks, scored 0 to 100, with a prompt that fixes it.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/slop
- Asset extractor: Every image, SVG, icon, video and font on the page, ready to download.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/assets
- Font finder: Every font a site uses, where it’s used, and free look-alikes.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/fonts
- Website to HTML: The page as HTML and CSS with its images and fonts, in one ZIP.
  https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/html

That’s 6 of 15 free tools (https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/tools). There’s also a color palette generator, a tech stack checker, screenshots and a responsive checker.

Using an AI agent? Connect Sitepeel’s MCP server (https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/mcp) and it can run the same tools for you in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Codex. That’s free too.

Coming soon: The Sitepeel Chrome extension will be free to use too. Colors, Fonts, Measure, Screenshot and the AI slop checker will be free for everyone, and every other tool gets free tries.

Try the free tools: https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/start

If something breaks, or there’s a tool you wish we had, just reply. I read every email.

Thanks,
Joseph from Sitepeel

---
You’re getting this because you have a Sitepeel account. Unsubscribe from news emails: https://sitepeel.dev/e/cefc10dd9bff39be8aca14f0b0ef47ce/unsubscribe
Sign-in codes and receipts still arrive.
Sitepeel · https://sitepeel.dev

vercel logo ( https://vercel.com/login?utm_medium=email&utm_source=cio&utm_campaign=vif )

Your domain, https://setthi.in is set up on Vercel, but your nameservers are still pointed at another DNS provider. This means you're managing DNS configuration separately from your deployments.

 

When you point your nameservers to Vercel, DNS records are created automatically when you assign a domain or subdomain to a project. SSL certificates are provisioned and renewed without configuration, and there are no additional records to set up or maintain.

 

How to update nameservers for this domain

1. Log into your domain registrar
2. Replace your current nameserver records with:
  * ns1.vercel-dns.com
  * ns2.vercel-dns.com
3. Once that's done, log in to your Vercel dashboard and check https://setthi.in's status.

Nameserver changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate.

* Change your nameservers ( https://vercel.com/docs/domains/working-with-nameservers?utm_medium=email&utm_source=cio&utm_campaign=vif )

** How teams ship with Rive
------------------------------------------------------------

From Spotify Wrapped to full games, teams use Rive to build interactive experiences that run natively across every platform.
READ MORE ON THE BLOG   ❯ (https://rive.app/blog?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=state_machine)


** Featured teams
------------------------------------------------------------

🎵 Spotify Wrapped (https://rive.app/blog/spotify-wrapped?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=state_machine) — built with Rive, it drove the highest single-day subscriber growth in Spotify history
👥 LinkedIn Year in Review (https://rive.app/blog/buck-linkedin-year-in-review?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=state_machine) — 207,360 personalized journeys across three languages, built by BUCK
🌹 Duolingo (https://blog.duolingo.com/world-character-visemes/?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=state_machine) — AI-powered video calls bring character Lily to life
🎮 Pocketwatch Games (Monaco 2) (https://rive.app/blog/pocketwatch?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=state_machine) — all game UI, menus, and 2D graphics built in Rive

messages.subject: Final notice: new tables in "public" need grants from October 30.
messages.body_text:
10 days left: new tables in "public" need explicit grants from October 30.

Hi there,

On October 30, ten days from now, Supabase will stop automatically granting Data API access to new tables in the "public" schema for existing projects.

 

Your existing tables are not affected. They keep their current grants and stay accessible through the Data API.

 

What changes on October 30

 

Any table created in "public" from that date onwards needs an explicit GRANT before supabase-js, PostgREST, or GraphQL can reach it. Without one, the API returns a "permission denied" error that includes the statement to run.

This includes migrations that recreate your schema: new projects, preview branches, and local "supabase db reset".

What to do

Add grants in the same migration that creates each table:

grant select

on public.your_table

to anon;

grant select, insert, update, delete

on public.your_table

to authenticated;

grant select, insert, update, delete

on public.your_table

to service_role;

Check which tables are exposed in your project's Data API settings ( https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/integrations/data_api/settings ).

Learn more about this change ( https://github.com/orgs/supabase/discussions/45329 )

If you have any questions, please reach out to our support team ( https://supabase.com/dashboard/support/new?subject=Breaking%20Change%20-%20Data%20API%20Exposure ).

 

The team at Supabase

** Build faster with the AI Agent
------------------------------------------------------------

Rive's AI agent writes code for you right in the editor. Describe what you want, and it turns your ideas into working logic. Designers have used it to build entire games, particle systems, custom cloner tools, and interactive components.

It's an on-ramp if you don't code, and a speed boost if you do.
TRY THE AI AGENT   ❯ (https://rive.app/docs/editor/ai-agent/ai-agent?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=design_vs_animate#ai-agent)


** What people are building
------------------------------------------------------------

🎮 Full playable games (https://x.com/BobbehHaynie/status/2026500607503176021?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=design_vs_animate) — entire games built by designers with zero coding experience
⚙️ Physics systems (https://x.com/guidorosso/status/2026371691103006977?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=design_vs_animate) — real physics simulations built right in the editor
✨ Particle systems (https://x.com/guidorosso/status/2020875336603586799?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=design_vs_animate) — fire, smoke, confetti, rain, all generated with code
🔧 Custom tools (https://x.com/guidorosso/status/2020875164041547778?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=design_vs_animate) — cloners, path effects, and tools built right in the editor
🔄 Interactive components (https://x.com/drawsgood/status/2019160228286153020?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=design_vs_animate) — data-driven UI that responds to user input


** Learn more

messages.body_text:
Everything we announced at Select, and everything else that happened in the last month at Supabase

Supabase

********************************
Supabase Update — October 2026
********************************

Hey there 👋,

Here’s everything that happened with Supabase in the last month:

Build anything: Supabase from code, and an MCP server for your app

------------------------------------------------------------------
Build anything: Supabase from code, and an MCP server for your app
------------------------------------------------------------------

Your agent can now set up your backend from code, test changes locally, and deploy your web app and services next to your database.

Read the blog → ( https://supabase.com/blog/select-2026-build-anything )

Operate with confidence

-----------------------
Operate with confidence
-----------------------

New data, tools, and controls give your agent what it needs to observe your project, investigate issues, and propose fixes on its own. Pipelines now stream your Postgres data to BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckLake, and Snowflake in public alpha.

Read the blog → ( https://supabase.com/blog/select-2026-operate-with-confidence )

Scale without limits: Multigres, OrioleDB, and dbarena

------------------------------------------------------
Scale without limits: Multigres, OrioleDB, and dbarena
------------------------------------------------------

Multigres brings high availability and connection pooling to Postgres in private alpha, and OrioleDB, a high-performance storage engine, is now in Public Beta. DBARENA publishes open benchmarks that compare managed Postgres providers.

Read the blog → ( https://supabase.com/blog/select-2026-scale-without-limits )

Supabase is acquiring Turso

---------------------------
Supabase is acquiring Turso
---------------------------

Turso's multi-tenant SQLite platform lets an agent create a database as easily as creating a file, with on-demand provisioning and no dedicated machine required. Turso's Glauber Costa and Pekka Enberg join Supabase to build the infrastructure agentic workloads need, and existing Supabase and Turso databases keep running exactly as they do today.

Read the blog → ( https://supabase.com/blog/supabase-is-acquiring-turso )

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------
Quick Product Announcements
---------------------------

* Supabase is now a connector in Gemini Enterprise, so you can query your projects and take action in natural language next to GitHub, Linear, and Jira. [Blog ( https://supabase.com/blog/supabase-is-now-available-in-gemini-enterprise )]
* Logs move to usage-based pricing for ingest and query scanning, with more than 90% of projects inside the included limits and no charges until early 2027. [Changelog ( https://supabase.com/changelog/logs-usage-based-pricing )]

------------------
Made with Supabase
------------------

* Ekwo OS - open-source double-entry accounting for 90+ countries that installs onto your own Supabase project as Postgres migrations. [GitHub ( https://github.com/Ekwo-ai/ekwo-os )] [Website ( https://ekwo.ai )]
* Atomic CRM 1.6 - marmelab's open-source CRM now ships a built-in MCP server that runs as an Edge Function with OAuth. [GitHub ( https://github.com/marmelab/atomic-crm )]
* Supabuckt - an open-source Storage browser for Android and iOS, built with Kotlin Multiplatform, that switches between your projects. [GitHub ( https://github.com/hieuwu/supabase-storage-client )] [Website ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/supabuckt-supabase-storage/id6759938222 )]
* NO SUS - a student privacy toolkit with burn-after-read encrypted notes and watermarked file sharing, built on Flutter and Supabase. [Website ( https://nosus.foo )]

--------------------
Community Highlights
--------------------

* How I'd Launch a Dating App From Zero: Supabase Growth Strategy. [Video ( https://youtube.com/watch?v=xP8JEnWzGEA )]
* Why MCP is the key to building with Supabase, from Stripe Developers. [Video ( https://youtube.com/watch?v=6pIiR7-TbJo )]
* Supabase Is Quietly Becoming a Data Platform. [Video ( https://youtube.com/watch?v=0RYFbRxXDv8 )]
* supabase-audit runs 11 read-only checks for RLS, exposure, and performance footguns from one SQL file. [GitHub ( https://github.com/Concepto505/supabase-audit )]
* Six Multiplayer Browser Games on Cloudflare Workers and Supabase: What Broke. [Blog ( https://dev.to/board_it_b11ff7d58bf863f8/six-multiplayer-browser-games-on-cloudflare-workers-and-supabase-what-broke-5244 )]

messages.subject: [Action Required] Update thinking_budget and sampling parameters
messages.body_text:
Google AI  
Studio<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmwRN1YWzTbQBcW-GAINMhfIn3-gPoLPko8y8q9u5ObH2SuLUr3F82GCLLqWbSI--1CMmfIQkLhKRA_fyKF216c_1ktKHfoIqKqkYe1uecuT8QJmyvHGbAmFLB-ZMgW5DFQAgRZfo4RdE56yyIf>

🟡  Parameter Deprecation

Migrate from thinking_budget to thinking_level and remove custom sampling  
parameters

You are receiving this notice because your project recently sent Gemini API  
requests containing deprecated generation parameters: thinking_budget,  
temperature, top_p, and top_k.

What is changing

Starting with our upcoming Gemini models, here is what is going to change.  
Read our documentation to learn  
more<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmOZTAlvax7q0L7ZjCiODtVZ1rQ6AdLjEtsoKP669tALtlHbZBv5nqTUqc0rUKqilrTJ5KWwUQ11FrQZinX6rfouiYYDR16sIxOC5D1Efgk2qWV7CbGQDj_KBAjy7LUi8K1xKeXHtmf7OHHPOwRJs82C0yBLlUndeeElQN9HS9GS6RGX9EtzCzrL97K9dNYIMrJVBGGw4vRI0bMg_sXHw>.

- Thinking budget will fail with an error
Gemini 3 series models have accepted thinking_budget values through a  
fallback to thinking_level. Starting with our upcoming models, requests  
that set thinking_budget will no longer be remapped and will return 400  
INVALID_ARGUMENT.

- Sampling parameters are deprecated
Since Gemini 3.6 Flash, sampling parameters have been set to default  
values, so custom values have had no effect on model output. Soon with our  
upcoming models, requests that include temperature, top_p, and top_k  
parameters will return an error.

What you need to do

- Replace thinking budget with thinking level
Set thinking_level ("minimal", "low", "medium", or "high"), or omit it to  
use the model default. Supported levels vary by model; see the supported  
thinking levels per  
model<https://c.gle/AAuDWvksuoFqNczptQ9yKuCC--InNPj_C6IN5fjoZc225I_jwVIns8z7-BAUryoPTFhzRcIZGIRNeVxIp5rXg4LnoNyhzewtpheIv05oLa26EgK7R5xudxjmNwwMtdGXWrRWfMNLgF1ixYkrioC7OnPrS2tI3U0jBJcMvpyZEmelYSWoZD83nyMqyoIew6VDBLOSAxO1k3zKd2uGky0wqISBlsQD2g>.

- Remove temperature, top_p, and top_k
Delete these fields so the model uses its optimal default sampling settings  
and to avoid errors in future releases.

Note: The Interactions  
API<https://c.gle/AAuDWvlzmB_DGglVEZLlJOmnZzx4fChE3FvHEV4pq9y4VAlcMdBStv_6KfshHP18JCUkYeeRoSff3ptRggfn37K-dQGcEq54_nTdO962e3j2x09FJ3WFz2KeuEA2N05J_bRjptzPvrelXstANBHzS4d6r0PR1edxLk_R-dsJ1dt-l4dQkh8jJD0QA8Y>  
is now in GA and recommended for all new projects. While the  
generateContent API remains fully supported, it is now legacy, and we  
encourage teams to migrate.

from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

# ⚠️ Remove temperature, top_p, and top_k

# ✅ Use thinking_level

interaction = client.interactions.create(

model="gemini-3.8-flash",

input="Solve this logic puzzle...",

generation_config={"thinking_level": "high"}

)

print(interaction.output_text)

Automate this migration with a coding agent

If you use a coding agent that supports skills (like Antigravity), install  
the gemini-api-dev  
skill<https://c.gle/AAuDWvm-t54QaGATGvr4nCs8wfGzBMlXqihiDpTyClBQnSLEA2oUkKhztD5e-I31E3kIydpGBmvcqY5zm-sf5syj49iNWko4LZJukQEfZlVmo-7YwyJ5lepcyaxxSWUzvzxqEuDSMH1txorppFbmIzo409-t5tFkQt6FCoYVmZDF8ctq3zMhFQ>  
and run:

/gemini-api-dev migrate my app to Gemini 3.8 Flash

- Get  
support<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmIasjc3lX8XSlN3UeRzgw1rcsbQw1ac_q_mlmnJvF6h6AOCOoW2-r--yp5xd0v-egVTDCx2RQmrHnLIrCrDI_1y32HT2kPpJ5cCJas6OWr0yJrP5B46jVvPgz1NgwGEj3XHGvk5WxX-qdOceA>

- Manage API

messages.subject: Your fastest path to learning Rive
messages.body_text:
View this email in your browser (https://us13.campaign-archive.com/?e=b0ecbba7b4&i=04a0f417ea&u=42cf7cf7cadda0b6e64dbf403&id=d22260da4a)
https://rive.app?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating


** Your fastest path to learning Rive
------------------------------------------------------------

We recommend the full Rive 101 series (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsFGonP9kzAnvryowW098-p3&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) , but if you want to jump straight to what matters most to you:

🎬 Animation (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsEfxEXKpAc3qNRXo2OYs_CR&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — keyframes, interpolation, blend states
⚡ State Machines (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsF2ohb_L4cToMWIN8YI9P8P&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — make it interactive without writing code
💻 Scripting (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsEcbpuhsWfJAZGzy5piMWYi&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — a real programming environment in the editor, powered by Luau (https://rive.app/blog/why-scripting-runs-on-luau?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating)
🔗 Data Binding (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsG8MHxGI3S5wGYbkL6e-CUI&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — connect your UI to live data
📐 Responsive Layouts (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsGvor80PkjHaZ3hNNo6s_ef&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — build interfaces that adapt to any screen size
📚 Libraries (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsHvEj-JdEiiJ-6UDbnzMv7X&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — publish once, reuse everywhere in your project
🧶 Character Rigging (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsG_mWW-YylLaFaPWP1jgwoc&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — bones, constraints, and skeletal animation
WATCH RIVE 101   ❯ (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsFGonP9kzAnvryowW098-p3&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating)


** Rive Direct
------------------------------------------------------------

Short, focused videos straight from the team. Each one tackles a specific feature or workflow so you can learn exactly what you need in a few minutes.

💻 Scripting: Getting started (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zh76EkkkjI8&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — write your first script in the editor
✨ AI prompt → your own art (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zp119_RaBb0&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — AI gets you started. Your animation and design make it real.
🎮 Control Rive files in Unity (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DpmsragqAxM&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — integrate interactive Rive content in your game
🔨 Build a Cloner (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5OB-MPZo-v4&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) — learn how to build your own tools
BROWSE RIVE DIRECT   ❯ (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsGU_PFWKpdUd4RQASOd7OKf&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating)


** Docs
------------------------------------------------------------

Prefer reading? The Rive documentation (https://rive.app/docs?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=star_rating) covers everything from getting started to advanced runtime integration.

============================================================

messages.body_text:
View this email in your browser (https://us13.campaign-archive.com/?e=b0ecbba7b4&i=3c5a729614&u=42cf7cf7cadda0b6e64dbf403&id=6e23cfa5b9)
https://rive.app?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome


** Welcome to the experience engine
------------------------------------------------------------

Spotify. Duolingo. Legendary game studios. Automakers building next-gen HMI. They all ship interactive experiences built with the Rive engine.

Design, animate, and code in a single editor instead of stitching tools together. Ship to any platform through our open-source runtimes. Higher quality, faster iteration, no handoff.
DOWNLOAD DESKTOP APP   ❯ (https://rive.app/downloads?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome)


** Get started
------------------------------------------------------------

🎬 Quick start tutorial (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wnwA0izJo4E&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome) — build an interactive menu from scratch

🎨 Remix (https://rive.app/marketplace?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome) — learn by exploring what others have built

🤖 Try the AI agent (https://x.com/guidorosso/status/2020875164041547778?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome) — ask it to explain features or build things for you


** Keep learning
------------------------------------------------------------

🎥 Rive 101 (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsFGonP9kzAnvryowW098-p3&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome) — the complete video series covering every major feature, from animation basics to scripting and data binding

⚡ Rive Direct (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLujDTZWVDSsGU_PFWKpdUd4RQASOd7OKf&utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome) — short, focused videos from the team tackling specific features and workflows

📚 Docs (https://rive.app/docs?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome) — the full reference for everything from getting started to runtime integration


** Join the community
------------------------------------------------------------

💬 Official support (https://community.rive.app?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome) — ask questions, share work, get help

👾 Discord (https://discord.gg/FGjmaTr?utm_source=MailChimp&utm_campaign=drip_campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_term=welcome) — chat with the team and other creators

messages.body_text:
Get the most out of Gemini on web

Welcome to Gemini, an AI assistant from Google that can help you  
supercharge your creativity and productivity. With the Gemini web app, you  
can get help writing, creating, learning, and more at  
gemini.google.com<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmkAb43jl0T-0FKETlvUSFcZ_3ENBWlaR9brJSzVts-ks-Zcs1SXf1_4miF8WiwOOIHwolIN6xpWGDLHAqtMVUs0JMNV8dr1G8uoFElUKX2fjgtGAjX4BkXdou3BQvm_rxHm62_LZNh>>.  
Learn  
more<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvlkmkj172yYOr3RTnWd-_y3LBVQfAciJWeYh5vHNY3B-kfwAePR7efo9KbaMtiWhUjc9bcvLbd7fZQxVge6k-VYzkzwWetrwidMxkK-TjXqw_dS6QFllJf5GhNkqfKP7kHdEr22DhixRoSH5qhAVjqi3wAtBuPm1KtgKdBdrrJM>>  
about what you can do with Gemini on the web.

How Gemini handles data and works with other services

Gemini activity and your choices

Your chats, what you share with Gemini (like files, videos, screens, and  
photos), audio, transcripts, and recordings of your Gemini Live  
interactions, your feedback, info from websites you visit with Gemini,  
product usage, and location  
info<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvn4cryt1Td48xMRnbVWRy6LJ8H1W1iRA3fsTzeYVPWshmgeiwxWRbOIKOlMJZPqUNtA7sLhms_HoQx2wRL4fGwtBdz2jNaB2UFazA6mq4VXlMgLl2T0TBo82f5FfOEzn-kwfN_KSTOUUYsaXCoY>>  
are saved in Gemini Apps  
Activity<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmJY67PvsvxG3a3DfeVVoOXrq2fga-aCLJMhdnNdv9zihU42dzmVTbMrEUMfPVc9ri3k3CpKr46efrjgVVr9V9M6p9V0yCG1jXt2k7G7xLqGctYpXECZf7lv8rmgk67aUAl4tihx-Dg2LlsZW-esPmKzHZByuzLERcVaLlc5g>>  
(if your Keep Activity setting is on). This data is reviewed by trained  
service providers and used to improve Google services (including Gemini  
models<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvkemUlcG_TGFePhMieizvUaEtBZhw5Z8cBg8eUf0wu5tl47AwZbCAB2WU5eXt0fJmwpzFT2UGk4dlMSPJkQufGLIvQjj8CP2E52dvrglQA2-9qF9LA7vI9EL4-qdU-ysnm68FIptCIwCJ6UfvujEWPOQeCvRTKE>>  
and other generative AI models). It’s also used to personalize your  
experience<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmchlzhea137FAwm7VJjt3LCMsD3ycgRH6VthEtaZIAYazmQHL8YRpG1OR6k2w71VD7m5dxL_Xxrzlo7nyy3Cl6tI_2u8URNuZLgIRPhXebZYgj2Io97IpyKhTQizu-5vAey6H3UkrGhg1xhoiAPo_wn9p32iGmf7LJbzPrHAT6cBwppydUhuhSDzsnujWLOaC-HglAk3uoiA>>,  
depending on your settings and region. When Google uses your activity to  
improve its services, it gets help from human reviewers. To protect your  
privacy, chats are disconnected from your account before being sent to  
service providers for review. You can turn off Keep  
Activity<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvlH052OPIoG18piaLd5YInjJW8c153Y9mCJLranjcc2Eii1aunRmEjclqFypqR0s8OUaKKlNt78mvJVqi8nbyU9RvmPh6Sim0s7PeDYsokiVPbYhRCATaE5bxfktmw2AB4O2Vx-YqM84NqqSOSKMq5D9mE3Al9BY9XQDoJrJ87svAd947A-AK4Z>>  
anytime. Be sure not to include info you wouldn’t want reviewed or used.

Gemini works with other services

Gemini can respond with real-time info from other tools, apps, and services  
like Google Maps and YouTube. You can also choose to connect services like  
Google Workspace and YouTube Music. If Gemini finds a connected app that  
can help, it will send information from your conversation and other  
relevant information to that connected app to help it generate a better  
response. You can manage your apps in your settings. Learn  
more<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvkKCYZLZmjvDqj3E5c0ojWmqI-n-w9w29LLBG7b5jbiATJa_FN9x2Kj0Tks83W9UnekPFtso-jpKA6Ym62JcvJkOcHc9k8l70bUEA0juVP_lzvf4r8dQuWP6I4coLy9-mfnYzEnMlbklg5U12wDc6v9ntURFv5yhrnfjjFzfIqmWY6IjX_LXw4uBw>>.

Things to know

• You can  
request<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvlzMN1dyVAlvsrlF1ZSKWQK4iJ62h-X3OBN-Pky3qr8cZsb3qMqadlh-wYxaik8_LbHIwFr71XCEBoaQEH2w8NVjGAAAy2uGCDkI_gqxbuhGSp5Qjhne7o8tRpmNSs9CVFfJGAWb4TC2Y0y1n4XDGAnxZWeTP5UKVQa2mGsy2DqpSZDyIp__x-5tJOlYfrsy2kUI7rqRleTj4Q>>  
the removal of content under our policies or applicable laws. You can also  
export<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvkYnkoH8t3_bo9-tW2rZ8vhWwo7Mj0A4b0dpvQkTnPY4uidMiYzLlVg_Mrxh6RXdsY_xMgdD9tmbeRNNW68TWGutMWMAH4Rtb8gasJ1_L8eTTbWTf74Rf933rfsjtd9vMYFz7iukdSTzoY_hBhRwts>>  
your information.

• Gemini Apps are continuously evolving and may produce inaccurate  
information<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvm2cghJknAeVKRYCp5LhDo8BKlz1a7Ri50KRmRFKl-MOj6McvqafuFIcFBeDWjfrRBBvagjyQ1BzwpMXVj58zrByyYNqqeRHsEymru4qx_tZlpoVQdDl-KhKf2c0ZJlDkQmsAM3tb-q21JrInbvNNLX4n67SyKBF2OO0HnxXzzRGjvJYKO1FmSs>>  
(including about people) that doesn’t represent Google’s views.

• Don’t rely on responses from Gemini Apps for diagnosis, treatment, or  
medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice. Its output is for  
informational purposes only.

• Monitor Gemini’s browsing closely and interrupt if needed.


• Your  
feedback<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmqYBm3edncKgUSlro1Sx48_R8RGbpxcbtOFeYCcSh_NnZXbRh55aT6KIF9vaB3FmSkeLgI6nNESU_ShPr_oYQIiUvDs_X6l_YjKFr9HWdqy2_ljXFTcDixitjijvzyG98GJZ_u7720WAdij9H_FH4txUqSTm1TQyDzbVZzXxUMWLkNNChiLv8A8joK>>  
will help make Gemini better.
Note: Google Terms of  
Service<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmjrb76L_PlSnT59b9_ULxzgzMAZlIMVuDNHJLGsCl_qGscqmRosUWRdCugc31O2ekWmGvZMENwaV0J-7ADf7_oA-9NLl2tRB12e8zqR-kItazM2x_QIiHDYPLok54Y-RFXKv6s4XqwMyBipZzI7p7_gmWj7xg>>  
and the Generative AI Prohibited Use  
Policy<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvl8Zf6goWiSNh_dcln599f2DNsmDKtNvPjd3CFVwKbzfQ9k60HyGILruyFtVcF3DL_0XYeJe3y1MUghEw37o3S4p9JNgkibsL-PC0GsQRUxqv6rsBCFGSmGWGcgSnbdvOoaOFJzSLKF9d8_QY2tIoEe-YclTh41BTdtBVE7PRWrUbEw8TczejTw1ZdBvGDS2_gVje1q--8yeYee>>  
apply to Gemini  
Apps<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvkILG-e1ANFzghV6VScZkKAW8uGtAU5LcCNKScX_ikU7jKJd6VNKehcX5wLjsyQsDX0WBWntOjaPRaMWUljtgIQXR2egmf5H5bCX2uL7pV5GMPgeL_B-MJL_GINWzcmL2RENsd_TClKNbNWex6p0KL4qQ6oQJgUqslxokdEIxgehQA>>.  
Google will process your data as described in the Google Privacy  
Policy<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvlSKTTr6XLHFLF4CaFPJQ1Xpyng5n0RhI9KysiOYrFPfEJE0P9C1QaYKLuLtxr_DeTmpfUDsqzQPqsG8xflATnumIYFqgGMvIZvCCDpiB73kyhnou7EMgi6dos2K2t2EtdCGkH_nMk1rBJE9Vq2qI4WTBNKNiU>>  
and the Gemini Apps Privacy  
Notice<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmYzs63x6jrg8Bj03A0QZ2ITLdUmpy79-FkSDuXp0i_DCo6NnALOXNY2940bKggOADueFEZH1oNKJN6LW44GMPXuu5aWBw8iuUjSRepU_r9BT22CaCR1eQUtkzN_IhJu1YiymgDWCB3UW6gXlEoovhiohMmV9xeEL1zbDI1A1o14X0rM9ycaWXYq0DFs_BR0gD-ZCQe9L3qjsLWCXPL>>.  
Gemini can make mistakes, including about people, so double-check  
it<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvnBeEaQg8r1sPNs1-sfu88a1FF1836-hxcM5WK2gOwPasAasJ-chnw7fctRGgbgt4UWBl16rYrxYURqnPftMC42bq4wNk9jnuMkqCPi6uKdiA462bW9CdjMDLCZrygaLn85Px6pIoCKZXB4uxF_SBJWglcaUyFKWaWwwl3wLmfQNfl7pQ>>.  
Respect others’  
rights<<https://c.gle/AAuDWvmiT09DZ406mqAV5qbkoQPC6KwFV96TyEcSyy1ydAs33uAX9xS6lVsS_9otG-doJ_oaeC_V0M39udY9ejvfnYHLr0RiCUqJWN-TgW5NEtqwZ4VGSZf7y5ExplM7zSh-U73oy5SvkzdjBu9oyIyPADQ8bTNl4AL69NHPfI-5UiiBDJuYn6_a6ljNrapNxcO-C9bIgw>>

messages.subject: New tables in public need explicit grants from October 30
messages.body_text:
Your existing tables keep working. Only tables you create after October 30 need a GRANT.  

Hi there,

On October 30, Supabase will stop automatically granting Data API access to new tables in the public schema for existing projects.

 

Nothing changes for your existing tables. They retain their current grants and remain accessible through supabase-js, PostgREST, GraphQL, and other client libraries. No action is required to keep your app running.

 

What changes on October 30

 

Any new table created in public needs an explicit GRANT before the Data API can reach it. If a grant is missing, the API returns a permission denied error with the exact GRANT statement to run.

Migrations count too. From October 30, any migration that creates a table without the required grants leaves that table unreachable through the Data API. That includes new projects, preview branches, and a local "supabase db reset". Add grants to those migrations now.

What to do

Add grants in the same migration that creates the table:

grant select

on public.your_table

to anon;

grant select, insert, update, delete

on public.your_table

to authenticated;

grant select, insert, update, delete

on public.your_table

to service_role;

Check which tables are exposed in your project's Data API settings ( https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/integrations/data_api/settings ).

Learn more about this change ( https://github.com/orgs/supabase/discussions/45329 )

If you have any questions, please reach out via our support portal ( https://supabase.com/dashboard/support/new?subject=Breaking%20Change%20-%20Data%20API%20Exposure ).

 

The team at Supabase

messages.body_text:

<https://notifications.google.com/g/vib/ACT4xYwIQwx7p4_3BQ_4lgvSg7aduEuvEh3G7xaAkeRgUr6jLrxnHcBJVyF6F6iwhR0WFpZ6j2WeO5snX_gvhys1nJU7qmvECqX3TfTz0oNYYTH8WaZt7IsFB2WsbrQOL5H2LRc>

Welcome to your Google Developer Profile

<https://c.gle/ACT4xYyzYEr0heMJSJDzf3Iiw2QTsIHUEzTseCqFpDN5h8wJW9Q3iDRXmE0L4pA4bpfaA8tCmbIf2FQMbyPWgv06PFBC_W2gsMcG6qYQDWR1BxW4CO6yHYgLr7JzHQevSWsMc3X4pG1HjMds2_VIkEp6179ecFD-LqGlADJ08b4ofoGZi79wMqqnQMSpEok>

Hi there,

Thanks for joining the Google Developer Program. It’s great to have you on  
board.

The Google Developer Program is designed to help you get the most out of  
Google for Developers and accelerate your coding journey by making  
documentation more useful, training more accessible, and achievements more  
tangible. This program gives you access to new benefits such as AI-powered  
tools using Gemini models, personalized experiences based on your  
development interests, and connection to a thriving community of Google  
developers and experts.

To get the most out of the program and personalize your experience, visit  
your profile page and update your settings  
<https://c.gle/ACT4xYwSUg-nLkmgwdfoojruhZZ-r6se0Viz54O3ZsRS2Y1fdj1AEj85ZIw3-oIo35jl4VdNriW514a9a-sfPiwVlmK0inYLDzuikzlOKazZ0vtWg96wOYDl_M5bj3FX3WJ_R3y2gWGT2PIWF9eOaVhDCHpXJ11BbnBYwxCXLtRO9pPRw8vNamp6T5yG>  
with the topics you're interested in.

Start now  
<https://c.gle/ACT4xYzXsaJ2KAK9HDAqnTgGVIC_Otzr0koF3EPqb1e_RUrLRQCtkQEKhwt6p3CnohvdulDveJngUWRN0-Ww0vRwzSh5OpfNzl85zYgo0zTUBqhhmuRPwndnaAWJ1-aWgcVYOnrbdLE8dLAr4EyEIPk7NKvXuh0tPS07hbL2lbqXhtEuYs5q0ew6rA>

Here are some of the benefits you can now enjoy:

Solve problems with Gemini

Get answers to your coding questions, quick summaries of documentation, and  
relevant site search results with AI-powered tools using Gemini models.

Grow and share your success

Tailor your learning journey to your interests as you become proficient in  
Android, Google Cloud, Firebase, Chrome, and more. Organize your work,  
track your progress, earn badges, and share your achievements.

Thrive in a global community

Join communities like Women Techmakers and connect with developers and  
experts across the world. Unlock free learning credits with Google Cloud  
Innovators, gain access to exclusive events, and test new features.

messages.subject: Welcome to Supabase
messages.body_text:
Hey there,

Welcome to Supabase, the Postgres development platform.

Supabase gives you all the backend features you need to build a product: Database, Authentication, Storage, Realtime API, Edge Functions, Serverless APIs, and more.

Create your first project
https://supabase.com/dashboard/new/_
🔒 Planning for scale? Here's what matters:

- Harden your Data API: Replace the public schema with a custom schema so private tables are not exposed.
  https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/hardening-data-api
- Implement Row Level Security: Enable RLS on tables and create policies that filter data per user with proper indexing.
  https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security
- Review our Production Readiness checklist: Enable SSL enforcement, network restrictions, custom SMTP, and PITR backups for scale.
  https://supabase.com/docs/guides/deployment/going-into-prod

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or feedback.

Paul, CEO and Co-Founder @ Supabase

----------------------------------------
Supabase Inc, 3500 S. DuPont Highway, Kent 19901, Dover, Delaware, USA
